clue.text: Not half handsome, newspaper employee overate

indicators.note: keeping not half of a word means dropping its second half and holding on to the front portion only

explanation.definitionFit: To gorge is to stuff yourself greedily with food, so the past tense works as a straight synonym.

explanation.definitionFit: The garibaldi, named after the Italian general, is a flat British currant biscuit, sometimes jokingly called a squashed fly biscuit.
